plot_image_grid_rgb: plot a grid of RGBA images showing only the RGB channels using matplotlib subplots
plot_image_grid_alpha: plot a grid of images showing only the alpha channel for each image
plot_image_grid_custom_layout: plot images in a custom row and column grid layout with no spacing between them
plot_image_grid_with_axes: plot a grid of images with visible axes for debugging and inspection
plot_single_column_images: plot a single column of images stacked vertically with no gaps between them
